errors.evidence: The description claims that the Isolate and Uralic categories have the lowest permuted effects. This is an incorrect generalization. The permuted effects for IE-Indic (light and dark green bars) are the highest on the chart, reaching values of approximately 18 and 16, respectively. Additionally, the permuted effects for IE-Romance are similarly low to those in Isolate and Uralic (all are around 1-2), so the statement that Isolate and Uralic have 'the lowest' effects is inaccurate.
